title: A real-time MRI study on asymmetry in velum dynamics during VCV production with nasal sounds
abstract: We analyze velum dynamics in VCV production using real-time MRI, exploring asymmetry patterns during nasal contexts. Our study reveals significant asymmetries in velum movement patterns that correlate with phonetic context and articulatory constraints.

title: Implementation of Ripple Carry Adder and Carry Save Adder using 7nm FinFET Technology
abstract: This paper presents the implementation and analysis of Ripple Carry Adder and Carry Save Adder using 7nm FinFET technology, exploring the performance characteristics and efficiency of these arithmetic circuits in advanced semiconductor processes.

title: Development of In-Memory Wallace Tree Architecture using Block RAM
abstract: This research presents the development of an in-memory Wallace Tree architecture utilizing Block RAM, exploring novel approaches to arithmetic computation within memory structures for improved performance and efficiency.

title: A Study on Quantification of the Extent of Co-articulation in a VCV Sequence
venue: Journal of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
abstract: This study investigates the quantification of co-articulation effects in VCV (Vowel-Consonant-Vowel) sequences, providing insights into the articulatory dynamics and phonetic interactions in speech production.

title: Inter-subject variation in tongue shape during vowel production in /b/V/t/ sequence: An rtMRI study using 8 vowels from 74 subjects
abstract: This poster presents findings from a real-time MRI study examining inter-subject variation in tongue shape during vowel production in /b/V/t/ sequences, analyzing data from 8 vowels across 74 subjects to understand articulatory variability.
